title: Gym Jarvis · Ep 3
subtitle: Workout Analyser · FINAL script v6.3 board
lede: Complete Iron Man / JARVIS HUD look. Every skeleton, wave, ghost and verdict is drawn from real pose data on my own footage (15 and 28 Aug).
flow: v6 (creator's 15 notes): hook → months of effort, on weekends (Ep 1's 5 parts, SET SCAN circled) → Claude went through [N] papers and tools: counting reps is easy, judging them is hard, the camera angle can fool the agent → WAIT FOR IT · 3-2-1 · blast → 23 sets on trial across chest, back, legs, core → the system in 3 parts (line diagram) → PART 1 SEE (+ what if a joint is hidden?) → PART 2 JUDGE (best rep, same set) → false alarm on the lunge → PART 3 CHECK (STOP only when both say STOP) → chest flies: continue · reverse crunch: STOP, half reps → send this to the friend who says half reps count → Salesforce: news on top, the real posting below → how do you get ready? let's find out next time.
music_note: LOCKED (20 Nov): Desi Boyz 0-10 s at max energy (Edits), then Drum and Bass Vibes (Mixkit, 117 BPM, the most energetic candidate; different from last reel).
